title: Frontdesk workspace
confidenceHint: Confidence describes the available evidence. Match score describes the supported job criteria.
experienceNotScored: Not scored — experience requirement not met
provisionalScore: Provisional match score. Some criteria remain unverified.
internshipsExcluded: Internships do not count toward minimum experience.
experienceCounts: Professional months: {{professional}} · Relevant months: {{relevant}} · Required total: {{totalRequired}} · Required relevant: {{relevantRequired}}
noActiveRoles: No active openings are available for matching.
description: Create an opening, upload a CV and review the supporting evidence.
localNotice: Local test mode · AI profiles, embeddings and scores are simulated. Use sample CVs to test the flow.
recruiter: Recruiter · full access within this business
criteriaHint: Add job-related requirements. Do not use age, gender, religion or other protected characteristics.
openingLimit: Phase 1 supports one active opening per business. Criteria are entered by the recruiter.
uploadHint: One English PDF, DOCX or DOC, up to 10 MB.
uploadSuccess: CV received. Follow its processing status below.
duplicate: This CV was already uploaded. The existing record has been opened.
selectUpload: Select an upload to inspect its profile, result and CV evidence.
processing: Processing the CV. This page updates automatically while the worker runs.
failure: This CV needs recruiter review. A processing failure does not reject the candidate.

failureReasons.unsupported_language: Only English CVs are supported in this phase.
failureReasons.INVALID_PROFILE_CONTACT: The contact details could not be verified from the CV.
failureReasons.NO_USABLE_TEXT: The document did not contain enough readable text.
failureReasons.LOW_CONFIDENCE_EXTRACTION: The extracted text needs a recruiter to check it.
failureReasons.LOW_CONFIDENCE_PROFILE: The candidate profile needs a recruiter to check it.
failureReasons.IDENTITY_CONFLICT: The contact details match more than one candidate record.
failureReasons.INVALID_EVIDENCE: The AI's evidence could not be verified against this CV. No match score was published.
failureReasons.CV_TOKEN_CEILING_EXCEEDED: This CV exceeds the length limit for automated scoring. You can review the original file.
failureReasons.EXPERIENCE_REQUEST_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The experience check exceeds the AI provider's request limit. You can review the original CV.
failureReasons.FULL_TEXT_REQUEST_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: This CV and the role requirements exceed the AI provider's request limit. You can review the original file.
failureReasons.INVALID_MODEL_OUTPUT: The AI response did not pass validation. No match score was published.
failureReasons.MODEL_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE: The AI did not return a complete response. No match score was published.
failureReasons.EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: The AI assessed a requirement without supporting CV evidence. No match score was published.
failureReasons.RESUME_UPDATED: A newer CV was received for this candidate. Review the updated profile and matching result before continuing.
failureReasons.REAPPLICATION: This candidate has applied again. Review the current CV and previous application before continuing.
failureReasons.PDF_SANITIZATION_FAILED: A safe processing copy of the PDF could not be created. The original CV is available for review.
failureReasons.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI provider could not complete processing after retries. Review the original CV before making a decision.
failureReasons.AI_REQUEST_FAILED: The AI provider rejected a processing request. Review the original CV before making a decision.
failureReasons.PROCESSING_CONFIG_CHANGED: The processing configuration changed while this CV was being prepared. No new match score was published.
failureReasons.default: Processing could not be completed. Review the original CV before making a decision.

noEvidence: No supporting quote was returned for this criterion.
confirmReject: I confirm the final rejection after reviewing the CV evidence.
rejected: This rejection was confirmed by a recruiter.
retentionHint: Defaults are 7 and 30 days. Automatic deletion is disabled in the local demo.
memberHint: All members have the same permissions. Add an existing account by its user ID.
fileTooLarge: Upload a CV no larger than 10 MB.
